cohort: 60 COVID-positive pregnant women and 60 COVID-negative pregnant women
finding: Although most pregnant women with COVID-19 remain asymptomatic or have mild symptoms, the infection may increase the risk of early pregnancy loss, preterm birth, oligohydramnios, and cesarean section.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rate was slightly higher in the COVID-positive group, but the difference was not statistically significant.
